bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
DEPLOY=deploy-gaybbs-1
CANDIDATE=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:search-color-5a93de6
IMG="$(docker image inspect "$CANDIDATE" --format '{{.Id}}')"
ACTIVE="$(docker inspect "$DEPLOY" --format '{{.Image}}')"
LOCAL="$(docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local --format '{{.Id}}')"
test "$ACTIVE" = "$LOCAL" || exit 34
COMPOSE="$(docker inspect "$DEPLOY" --format '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project.config_files"}}')"
test -f "$COMPOSE" || exit 35
docker compose -f "$COMPOSE" -p deploy config -q || exit 71
LOG="$(mktemp)"
trap 'rm -f "$LOG"' EXIT
BACKUP=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:pre-search-color-5a93de6
docker tag "$ACTIVE" "$BACKUP" || exit 81
docker tag "$CANDIDATE" gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local || exit 82
activated=0
rollback(){
 if [ "$activated" != 1 ]; then
  current="$(docker inspect "$DEPLOY" --format '{{.Image}}' 2>/dev/null || true)"
  if [ "$current" = "$IMG" ] || [ "$current" = "$ACTIVE" ] || [ -z "$current" ]; then
   docker tag "$BACKUP" gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local || true
   docker compose -f "$COMPOSE" -p deploy up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  fi
 fi
}
trap 'rollback; rm -f "$LOG"' EXIT
if ! docker compose -f "$COMPOSE" -p deploy up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs > "$LOG" 2>&1; then
 python3 - "$LOG" <<'PY'
import pathlib,re,sys
s=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text(errors="replace")
for code,p in [(101,r'container name.*already in use|Conflict.*container name'),(102,r'OCI runtime create failed|failed to create shim task'),(103,r'operation not permitted|permission denied'),(104,r'failed to mount|mount source path'),(105,r'no such file or directory|file not found'),(106,r'network.*not found|network.*failed'),(107,r'failed to bind host port|port is already allocated'),(108,r'driver failed programming external connectivity'),(109,r'read-only file system'),(110,r'not a directory'),(111,r'container .* is not running'),(112,r'no space left|disk quota'),(113,r'image.*not found|manifest unknown'),(114,r'healthcheck|unhealthy|dependency failed'),(115,r'failed to create container'),(116,r'Error response from daemon'),(117,r'permission denied')]:
 if re.search(p,s,re.I):sys.exit(code)
sys.exit(118)
PY
fi
sleep 8
test "$(docker inspect "$DEPLOY" --format '{{.Image}}')" = "$IMG" || exit 92
test "$(docker inspect "$DEPLOY" --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true || exit 93
activated=1
trap 'rm -f "$LOG"' EXIT
exit 0
